dct_title_s: Cartes Particulieres des Isles de France, de Bourbon et de Rodrigue, and Carte Generale Des Isles, dont les figures
dct_alternative_sm: Cartes Particulieres des Isles de France, de Bourbon et de Rodrigue, and Carte Generale Des Isles, dont les figures
dct_description_sm: A Map of I. De France, I. Rodrigue, and I. Bourbon as they were in 1780.

Donated by Charles Leslie Ames.; Presently I. De France is known as Mauritius, and I. Rodrigue is the 10th district of Mauritius. I. Bourbon is now called Reunion Island. These three islands are off the east coast of Africa.
dct_publisher_sm: In Atlas De Toutes Les Parties Connues Du Globe Terrestre, Dresse, by Bonne Rigobert. J. L. Peelet., Geneva, Switzeland (1780)
